public_source_basis.claim_used: sums of high-frequency squared returns measure completed realized variation without supplying future direction.
public_source_basis.claim_used_2: open interest measures outstanding leveraged inventory and is used only through observations available by decision time.

mechanism.claim: When completed five-day and twenty-day BTC trends resolve from disagreement into one strict direction during elevated completed daily variation, short and medium risk transfer have newly synchronized. Follow the new common direction for seventy-two elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: new common strict sign of completed five-day and twenty-day BTC log returns
mechanism.why_distinct: STCR trades every fixed Monday/Thursday 3d/14d agreement state. HVMTI trades daily 5d/20d agreement only at a realized-variation below-to-above onset. HVTRR trades the disagreement-to-agreement trend transition under a current high-variation state. It uses no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current completed daily variation rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: daily multi-horizon trend-resolution transitions with 72-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 definitions

features.daily_path: 288 exact coherent BTCUSDT five-minute bars aggregated from 1440 unique one-minute rows in [D-24h,D)
features.daily_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of 288 squared five-minute intrabar log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.daily_close_history: exact completed UTC daily closes through D-5m, no imputation
features.trend_consensus: strict signs of return_5d and return_20d are identical
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 60, current excluded
features.resolution: current 5d/20d signs agree, immediately prior exact source-valid daily 5d/20d signs disagree, and missing prior cannot trigger
features.availability: D after every completed source bar is available

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: not a signal input; q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent multi-horizon trend disagreement-resolution mechanism under high variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure: source, novelty, train, test, eval, final; no threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
